USC.description:
Civilian carbine variant of the PDX-45 with a fixed stock and limited ammo capacity to comply with the strict importation rules of the Grand Federation.

Model submitted by Rialag.
USC.name: USC

C8A2.description: A Cascadian carbine with the aesthetics of the CAR-15 M16A2 Carbine. With a high firerate, fantastic close range performance and holds up well in range. However, it boasts a slower reload for its platform.
C8A2.name: C8A2

X95R.description: A modern revision of the Tavor, an Eretz-Kedem carbine, uniquely chambered in 5.45x39. It further improves on the TAR design with improved ergonomics by moving the charging handle and redesigning the stock. High fire rate with better torso performance, but below average damage.
X95R.name: X95R

GOLDEN DEAGLE 2.description: Carbine variant of the Juan Deag pistol.
GOLDEN DEAGLE 2.name: GOLDEN DEAGLE 2

GROZA-1.description: A Zarovian bullpup carbine with roots in the AKS74U, being identical internally to it. It shares the same magazines as AK47 or AKM rifles and was adopted in 1998. Strong recoil, especially with its firerate and higher than average velocity for 7.62x39mm.
GROZA-1.name: GROZA-1

GYROJET CARBINE.description: A prototype variant of the Gyrojet Mark I pistol. Stemming from the Gyrojet pistol, it shares the same loading and functionality of the pistol with a longer barrel, making ranged engagements easier. This particular carbine has the looks of the M16A1.
GYROJET CARBINE.name: GYROJET CARBINE

OTs-126.description:
A carbine variant of the PP-2000 machine pistol made for the civilian market.
However, this one in particular has been modified with the same trigger grouping as the military model.

Large magazine capacity with decently controllable recoil and great ranges.
OTs-126.name: OTs-126

GROZA-4.description: An integrally suppressed version of the Groza-1 firing 9x39mm. Excellent close-range performance with mild recoil, but a slower fire rate and smaller magazine.
GROZA-4.name: GROZA-4

KAC SRR.description: A revolver rifle variant of the RH-44 with a special suppressor also known as 'R-Squared'. High damage, slow muzzle velocity, low recoil, and a fast revolver firerate.
KAC SRR.name: KAC SRR

1858 CARBINE.description: A custom carbine variant of the 1858 New Army revolver. Very high damage capable of an instant kill to the head at any range, with a very slow fire rate and moderate muzzle velocity.
1858 CARBINE.name: 1858 CARBINE

SA58 OSW.description:
A Grand Federation DSA Arms SA58 in the Operations Specialist Weapon (OSW) configuration, which possesses a shorter barrel & modernized furniture for mounting of optics & accessories.

Lightweight with a larger than average magazine capacity for the caliber, but with somewhat rougher recoil and below average damage.

Model submitted by Rialag!
SA58 OSW.name: SA58 OSW

attachmentModifiers.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better equip, aim, walkspeed, and recoil recovery speed.
Accuracy is hindered from the lack of a stock.

MTS-569.description:
The MTS-569 is a civilian carbine derived from the RSh-12 assault revolver with a longer barrel and integrated stock.

Extremely high damage and recoil with relatively lackluster muzzle velocity.

Model submitted by ILLAXIS.
MTS-569.name: MTS-569
